S3-A3 reports that the four plumbing functions it added to _commit_ops.py have no binding onto GitEngine, so callers would have to reach into a package-private module; git_engine.py is where the binding block and the ADR-052 stability tier belong

S3-A3 proved that tests/core/test_git_engine.py's circular-import stub gives scistudio an empty __path__, which forbids every first-party leaf import in core/versioning, not just the cycle the guard exists to catch; the ADR-052 stability markers cannot be applied anywhere in the package until the stub is corrected

S3-C2 found that a generated packaged block declares version = <notebook commit> but _spec_from_class force-injects the distribution version and _resolve_block_version prefers the spec, so lineage stamps the SciStudio version instead of the commit; FR-054 makes the commit sha the link from a run back to its session, so the requirement is unmet without a fix in the registry spec or the scheduler's lineage
